Proposition
[Generic representation dimension] \group deformation theorySource: thurston:page-0098 If a presentation has $|\G |$ generators and $|\mathcal R|$ relators, and the relator map has surjective derivative at a representation, its local representation space has dimension $(|\G |-|\mathcal R|)\dim G$. When conjugation has full-dimensional orbits, the local deformation dimension is $\dim G(|\G |-|\mathcal R|-1)$.
Proof

\sketch Embed representations in $G^{\G }$, identify them as the identity fiber of the relator map, apply the implicit function theorem, and quotient by the conjugation orbit.

□
